game.coup.name: Coup
game.coup.desc: Bluff your way through a court of hidden identities: claim, challenge and block until only one player still holds influence.
game.coup.rule.1: Each player starts with two hidden influence cards. On your turn, claim any character's action, then anyone may challenge or block.
game.coup.rule.2: A challenge that fails costs the challenger influence; a true challenge costs the claimant. Last player with influence wins.
game.coup.challenge_prompt: {player} may challenge or allow the claim.
game.coup.block_prompt: {player} may block or allow the action.
game.coup.exchange_prompt.one: {player} must return one of the drawn cards to the court.
game.coup.exchange_prompt.other: {player} must return {count} of the drawn cards to the court.
game.coup.log_start: {players} players hide their influence; {player} acts first.
game.coup.log_income: {player} takes one coin from the treasury.
game.coup.log_foreign_aid: {player} takes two coins as foreign aid.
game.coup.log_tax: {player} claims the Duke and collects taxes.
game.coup.log_assassinate: {player} pays three coins and sends an assassin after {target}.
game.coup.log_steal: {player} claims the Captain and reaches for {target}'s purse.
game.coup.log_coup: {player} pays seven coins and launches a coup against {target}.
game.coup.log_show: {player} shows the {role}; the challenge is beaten.
game.coup.log_caught: {player} was bluffing and loses an influence.
game.coup.log_refund: {player} takes back the coins of the failed action.
game.coup.log_aid_done: {player} collects the two coins of the foreign aid.
game.coup.log_exchange: {player} claims the Ambassador and studies the court.
game.coup.log_exchange_done: {player} returns the extra cards to the court.
game.coup.reason_last_standing: {player} is the last player with influence and wins the coup.
game.coup.reason_turn_limit: The match reached its turn limit and is decided on surviving influence.
game.coup.error.unknown_action: This action does not belong to Coup.
game.coup.error.illegal_action: That action is not available now.
game.coup.error.bad_target: That is not a legal target.
